arm_and_dose_contract.opportunity_definition: one prior-record lookup chance per query before any same-event commit

field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Recomputes all scores from rows rather than prose.
field_principles.arm_and_dose_contract: Shows each arm got matched solver, query, opportunity, and charged budget.
field_principles.capacity_restart_rollback_rows: Records eviction, restart parity, and rollback parity.
field_principles.chronological_stream_commitment: Freezes the stream, thresholds, and held-future boundary before scoring.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_candidate_score: Bare scalar that is one only for exact safe positive held-future benefit.
field_principles.csl_execution_complete_score: Bare scalar that is one only when all planned rows are terminal.
field_principles.exact_answer_equality_rows: Proves every arm matches the exact release solver.
field_principles.exact_solver_is_release_authority: Bare true because exact answer equality is judged by the release solver.
field_principles.field_principles: Preserves why each artifact field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to gates, rows, exact replay, or tests.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names expected and observed gate values plus failed checks.
field_principles.held_future_support_rows: Measures charged held-future support and benefit by chain.
field_principles.honest_verdict: States the measured learning result and the exact-safety limits.
field_principles.immediate_metric_rows: Measures current-query utility after charged lookup and mapping cost.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares chronological exact conflict memory with no LLM.
field_principles.interference_rows: Measures unrelated-query abstention, safety, and extra charged cost.
field_principles.invalid_reuse_attack_rows: Shows unsafe reuse, leakage, and hidden-validation attacks were vetoed.
field_principles.lifecycle_action_rows: Records propose, validate, commit, use, abstain, evict, rollback, quarantine, and fallback.
field_principles.per_game_results: Reports one row per chronological unit and arm.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Combines all event and metric rows with source groups.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records solver versions, resources, stream commitment, and protected hashes.
field_principles.prefix_retention_rows: Measures old-prefix support after the full stream.
field_principles.prior_failure_receipts: Records why Exp6496 and Exp6498 did not open a held-future learning claim.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Proves protected upstream files did not change.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects later drift in rows, gates, code, or hashes.
field_principles.sequential_evidence: Proves decisions use only prior store state and sealed thresholds.
field_principles.status: Records whether the chronological conflict-learning comparison is positive, null, partial, blocked, or disqualified.
field_principles.store_hash_rows: Records before and after store hashes for every event.
field_principles.tests_run: Records validation commands and exit codes.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipt: Binds the run to the Exp6521 controller gate path, hash, and expected value.
field_principles.verdict_class: Uses positive only for charged held-future benefit with exact safety.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare false because the learning-benefit metric is not an oracle.
